name: Azul Straub
source: With a close bond to the family that rules Solstice, Azul is set on uncovering the disappearances happening right under his nose. Azul tries to remain calm, intellectual and composed, but can't help losing himself in the face of how others treat him in disguise. A troubled man who can't face the idea of losing anything else, who can't let his true face be uncovered.
